summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Market Study (Estudo de Mercado) new features. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). All 12 frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: new 'Concorre com qual produto MicroXisto?' dropdown with 17 products, admin dashboard by MicroXisto product, admin inline editing, Excel export.
seed_data_creation: Test market studies created during testing were cleaned up. Existing data: 6 market studies in DB, 1 with concorre_microxisto='Active' (Teste Corp / Produto XYZ)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new Market Study features implemented and working correctly. Key features verified: 1) 'Concorre com qual produto MicroXisto?' dropdown in market study form with 17 products (Magnus, Pullseed Ni, Pullseed G, Active, One-Max, Complex, MN-MAX, ZINMAX, S-MAX, Guardian, TRUCKER, CA-ULTRA, MG-ULTRA, Citro-X, Tek-F, Alvo, DTA) 2) 'Meus Registros' table shows 'Concorre c/ MicroXisto' column 3) Admin panel > 'Estudo Mercado' tab has 'Análise por Produto MicroXisto' dashboard with filter dropdown and Buscar button 4) Dashboard shows table with Menor Valor, Maior Valor, Valor Médio columns 5) 'Carregar Registros' loads ALL market studies from ALL users 6) Inline editing works - clicking 'Editar' converts row to editable inputs with 'Salvar' button 7) 'Baixar Excel' button present for export

concorre_microxisto_dropdown.details: Dropdown found with data-testid='market-concorre-select'. Contains 18 options (1 placeholder + 17 products). All expected products present: Magnus, Pullseed Ni, Pullseed G, Active, One-Max, Complex, MN-MAX, ZINMAX, S-MAX, Guardian, TRUCKER, CA-ULTRA, MG-ULTRA, Citro-X, Tek-F, Alvo, DTA

create_market_study_with_concorre_microx.details: POST /api/market-studies with concorre_microxisto field saves correctly. Field is optional.

meus_registros_table_column.details: 'Concorre c/ MicroXisto' column visible in 'Meus Registros' table

admin_analise_por_produto_dashboard.details: 'Análise por Produto MicroXisto' section found in Admin > Estudo Mercado tab. Has filter dropdown (data-testid='admin-microxisto-filter') and Buscar button (data-testid='admin-microxisto-search-btn')

admin_dashboard_table_columns.details: Dashboard table has columns: Produto MicroXisto, Concorrente (Empresa), Produto Concorrente, Menor Valor, Maior Valor, Valor Médio, R$/ha Médio, Registros

admin_carregar_registros.details: 'Carregar Registros' button (data-testid='admin-load-studies-btn') loads ALL market studies from ALL users. Shows 'Usuário' column with user emails.

admin_inline_editing.details: Clicking 'Editar' on a row converts it to editable inputs (7 input fields). 'Salvar' button appears for saving changes.

admin_baixar_excel.details: 'Baixar Excel' button (data-testid='export-market-btn') present. GET /api/admin/market-studies/export returns Excel file.

backend_post_market_studies.details: POST /api/market-studies with concorre_microxisto field works correctly

backend_get_admin_all_studies.details: GET /api/admin/market-studies/all returns all studies from all users

backend_put_admin_update.details: PUT /api/admin/market-studies/{id} allows admin to update any study

backend_delete_admin.details: DELETE /api/admin/market-studies/{id} allows admin to delete any study

backend_dashboard_by_microxisto.details: GET /api/admin/market-studies/dashboard-by-microxisto returns competitor analysis with min/max/avg values
